schemas.cfg: Reference and configuration data: status lookups, programme catalogue, academic reference lists, reason codes, work pools, calendar, parameters, and the approval-gated scoring configuration. Changes here are controlled and effective-dated.
schemas.idn: Identity: candidates and their personal profile, staff users, roles, pool membership, integration clients, duplicate-account pairs, ICP refresh requests and the candidate change history. Users are matched to IDAM by the IDAM immutable user identifier; no credentials are stored, the identity provider owns them.
schemas.app: Application: the application aggregate and its number counter, ranked programme/specialty/site preferences, versioned section data, the personal-information snapshot taken at submission, status history, withdrawal and reinstatement requests, direct screen-out reinstatements, contact verifications, plus the versioned form definition.
schemas.doc: Documents: type, metadata, versions, integrity hash, malware-scan status and storage status of uploaded files. File content itself goes through Rhapsody to the enterprise content store (FileNet).
schemas.pay: Payments: fee schedule, server-side provider routing, payment sessions, the immutable provider binding, normalised gateway events and reconciliation. No card data is stored.
schemas.ver: Verification: the officer review of a submitted application, assignment, correction requests, clarification, notes and screen-out recommendations. Verification has its own status, separate from portfolio and application status.
schemas.pfo: Portfolio scoring: the versioned rubric, the candidate's one-time portfolio submission, referee rounds and scores, conflicts of interest, discrepancy handling, score history and appeals.
schemas.scr: Screening and announcement: score components and weights, CASPER imports, candidate-visible score announcements and bulk screen-out.
schemas.ops: Operations: append-only audit trail (who, what, when, active role and client - never data values), idempotency keys, transactional event outbox, notification templates and queue, and scheduled-job history.

tables.cfg.AdmissionCycle: An admission intake year (for example 2026/2027). The year of its start date prefixes every application number of the cycle (for example 20270000001).
tables.cfg.AnnouncementStatus: Lookup of score-announcement states. Values equal the API enum.
tables.cfg.ApplicationStatus: Lookup of overall application lifecycle states. Values equal the API enum.
tables.cfg.Country: Countries used for academic history. The UAE flag drives the GPA input path.
tables.cfg.Degree: Catalogue of degree names a candidate can select.
tables.cfg.Discipline: Professional discipline of a programme, for example medical, dental or pharmacy.
tables.cfg.GpaConversionBand: One band of a GPA conversion set that maps a scale-of-4 range to a percentage range.
tables.cfg.GpaConversionSet: A versioned, effective-dated GPA-to-percentage conversion table. Content requires business approval before use.
tables.cfg.PaymentProvider: Supported payment gateways (E-Pay and Network International). Never shown to candidates.
tables.cfg.PaymentStatus: Lookup of payment session states. Values equal the API enum.
tables.cfg.PortfolioRoundStatus: Lookup of portfolio round states. Values equal the API enum.
tables.cfg.PortfolioStatus: Lookup of overall portfolio evaluation states. Values equal the API enum.
tables.cfg.Program: A programme offered, such as Residency, Fellowship, Internship or Certificate. Controls how many preferences a candidate may rank.
tables.cfg.ProgramCategory: Category of programme (Certificate, Internship, Residency, Fellowship).
tables.cfg.ProgramCycle: A programme opened in a specific admission cycle, with its application window, grace-period deadline and the time zone those deadlines are defined in.
tables.cfg.ProgramDegree: Links a programme to the degrees accepted for it.
tables.cfg.ReasonCategory: Grouping of reason codes by the process that uses them: WITHDRAWAL_REASON, CORRECTION_NOTE_TEMPLATE, SCREEN_OUT_REASON and REINSTATEMENT_REJECTION_REASON (the lookup types of the API).
tables.cfg.ReasonCode: Controlled reasons used when staff or candidates give a reason for an action, with a candidate-safe message.
tables.cfg.ScoringWeightItem: Maximum points for one scoring component within a weight set.
tables.cfg.ScoringWeightSet: A versioned, effective-dated set of scoring weights for a programme. Content requires business approval before use.
tables.cfg.SpecialtySite: A training site that hosts a specialty under a programme, with its capacity.
tables.cfg.SystemParameter: Tunable system settings (such as reminder or archive periods) stored as data instead of code.
tables.cfg.TrainingSite: A hospital or training site where candidates can be placed.
tables.cfg.University: Universities a candidate can select, by country.
tables.cfg.VerificationStatus: Lookup of verification case states. Values equal the API enum.
tables.cfg.WorkingCalendarDay: Working-day calendar used for due dates and overdue calculations.
tables.cfg.WorkPool: A pool of work items (verification, portfolio rounds, third referee, second evaluation) with an optional retrieval cap.
tables.cfg.DocumentType: Catalogue of document types that can be uploaded (personal photo, passport copy, CV, personal statement, recommendation letter and so on), with the allowed file types and maximum size.
tables.idn.Candidate: A person applying to a programme, matched to IDAM by the IDAM user identifier. Holds the 9-digit candidate number, the IDAM-registered contact data and hashes used to detect duplicate accounts. Personal details are in idn.CandidatePersonalProfile.
tables.idn.IcpRefreshRequest: A supervisor's ICP refresh for a candidate: the preview of ICP values (with a single-use token) and which fields were then applied.
tables.idn.AccessRole: Staff roles: administrator, admission officer, admission supervisor, central monitor, finance officer, referee, third referee, 2nd evaluation referee and senior referee.
tables.idn.StaffRoleAssignment: Grants a role to a staff user for a validity period, optionally scoped to a programme or specialty.
tables.idn.StaffUser: A staff member who works in the system, matched to IDAM by the IDAM user identifier, with the role currently in use and an optional link to the same person's candidate record.
tables.idn.CandidatePersonalProfile: The candidate's personal information (identity, documents, contact and next of kin) from the BRD personal-information section, held once per candidate (D-10). Each submitted application keeps its own snapshot.
tables.idn.DuplicateAccountPair: A pair of candidate accounts found to match on Emirates ID, passport or mobile at sign-in, kept for the supervisor's duplicate-account report. Matched values are not stored.
tables.idn.CandidateChangeHistory: Old and new value of every change to a candidate's personal data, by ICP refresh, candidate edit or staff correction. Kept apart from the audit trail, which never holds values.
tables.idn.StaffWorkPool: Which staff users work which work pools, and when. Source of the target officer and referee lists and of referee eligibility.
tables.idn.IntegrationClient: A system that calls the API on its own behalf (for example the payment middleware), identified by its IDAM client id.
tables.idn.IntegrationClientPermission: Permissions granted to an integration client, such as payments.events-write.
tables.app.Application: The application aggregate: one application of a candidate to a programme cycle. Holds the application number, the status, version for optimistic locking and key dates.
tables.app.ApplicationPreference: A ranked specialty choice within an application. At most two per application.
tables.app.ApplicationPreferenceSite: An ordered training-site choice within a specialty preference. The site must offer the chosen specialty.
tables.app.ApplicationSection: The current values of one application form section, stored as JSON and versioned. Personal information is not stored here; it is in idn.CandidatePersonalProfile.
tables.app.ApplicationSectionHistory: Immutable history of every saved version of a form section.
tables.app.ApplicationStatusHistory: Every status change of an application with who made it and why.
tables.app.FormField: A field within a form section, with its type, visibility and validation rules.
tables.app.FormFieldCondition: A rule making a field visible or required depending on another field's value.
tables.app.FormFieldOption: A selectable option for a single-select or multi-select field.
tables.app.FormSchemaVersion: A versioned form definition for a programme. Applications pin the version they were started with.
tables.app.FormSection: A section (page) of a form schema version.
tables.app.ReinstatementRequest: A candidate request to reinstate a withdrawn application, with the candidate's justification and the supervisor's decision.
tables.app.SiteExclusion: Records a site removed from a candidate's preferences after it was selected, with the candidate's free-text reason.
tables.app.WithdrawalRequest: A candidate request to withdraw an application, confirmed through a one-time password held by an external provider.
tables.app.ApplicationNumberCounter: Per-cycle counter that issues application numbers <cycle start year><7-digit counter>. One atomic update per new application guarantees a number is never issued twice.
tables.app.ApplicationPersonalSnapshot: The candidate's personal information exactly as it was when the application was submitted (D-15). Later profile edits or ICP refreshes do not change it.
tables.app.ScreenOutReinstatement: A supervisor's direct reinstatement of a screened-out application, with the justification and the statuses that were restored.
tables.app.ContactVerification: A one-time-code check of a changed contact e-mail or mobile number. Only a hash of the value is kept; codes are never stored.
tables.doc.Attachment: A file slot owned by an application (or the CASPER import), such as a form upload or portfolio evidence.
tables.doc.AttachmentVersion: An immutable version of an attachment: the content store reference, hash, size and malware-scan result.
tables.pay.FeeSchedule: The fee charged per programme cycle and fee type, effective-dated. Amounts need business approval.
tables.pay.PaymentGatewayEvent: A normalised, de-duplicated event received from a payment gateway.
tables.pay.PaymentProviderBinding: The provider and routing version a payment session is permanently bound to. Cannot be changed once written.
tables.pay.PaymentReconciliation: Resolution of an unknown or disputed payment against the original provider.
tables.pay.PaymentRoutingConfiguration: A versioned server-side setting that decides which provider new payment sessions use.
tables.pay.PaymentSession: One payment attempt for an application fee, with amount snapshot, status and idempotency key.
tables.ver.ClarificationRequest: A question from a verification officer to a supervisor and the supervisor response.
tables.ver.CorrectionFlag: A single field flagged for correction by an officer, with a comment.
tables.ver.CorrectionRequest: A request returning an application to the candidate for correction, with a due date.
tables.ver.ScreenOutRecommendation: An officer's recommendation to screen out an application and the supervisor's decision. The decider must be a different person.
tables.ver.VerificationAssignment: Records which officer owns a verification case, including past owners.
tables.ver.VerificationCase: The verification review of one submitted application, with its own status.
tables.ver.VerificationEvent: Timeline of what happened on a verification case.
tables.ver.VerificationNote: Internal officer notes on a verification case. Not visible to candidates.
tables.pfo.Appeal: A candidate appeal against the portfolio score. One per application.
tables.pfo.AppealQuestion: A portfolio question a candidate disputes in an appeal, with a comment.
tables.pfo.ConflictOfInterest: A referee's declaration of conflict of interest on a portfolio, with the mandatory reason. The referee can never be assigned that portfolio again.
tables.pfo.Portfolio: The candidate's one-time portfolio submission, tied to a rubric version.
tables.pfo.PortfolioAnswer: A candidate's answer to one rubric question. Immutable after submission.
tables.pfo.PortfolioAnswerEvidence: Links a portfolio answer to its supporting attachment.
tables.pfo.PortfolioDiscrepancy: Marks that Round 1 and Round 2 disagree and a third referee is needed.
tables.pfo.PortfolioDiscrepancyDetail: The individual questions on which Round 1 and Round 2 scores differ.
tables.pfo.PortfolioQuestion: A question in a rubric version, with its scoring type and maximum score.
tables.pfo.PortfolioRound: An evaluation round (Round 1, 2, 3 or second evaluation) for a portfolio.
tables.pfo.PortfolioScoreHistory: Every computed portfolio score. The latest row marked final is the effective score.
tables.pfo.QuestionClassification: Scoring classifications and points available for a question.
tables.pfo.QuestionRejectionReason: Reasons a referee may use to reject an answer to a question.
tables.pfo.RoundAssignment: Assigns a referee to a round. One referee per portfolio, and none after a conflict of interest.
tables.pfo.RubricVersion: A versioned scoring rubric for a programme cycle. Only one version may be active.
tables.pfo.ScoreItem: A referee's decision and score for one answer in one round.
tables.pfo.ScoreItemRejectionReason: The rejection reasons attached to a rejected score item.
tables.pfo.PortfolioStatusHistory: Every change of a portfolio's status, used to restore the previous status when an on-hold portfolio is reinstated.
tables.pfo.RoundScoreOverride: A senior referee's override of a completed round total, with the previous and new total and the mandatory justification.
tables.scr.ApplicationScoreComponent: One scored component (GPA, exam, portfolio, CASPER) for an application, with the weight version used.
tables.scr.ApplicationScreening: Current summary of an application's scores and announcement status.
tables.scr.BulkScreenOut: A bulk screen-out action with its selection criteria.
tables.scr.BulkScreenOutItem: The outcome of a bulk screen-out for one application.
tables.scr.CasperImport: One versioned CASPER result upload for an admission cycle, with row counts.
tables.scr.CasperImportRow: A raw CASPER row as received, with how it was processed.
tables.scr.CasperResult: The CASPER result applied to an application. Only one is current.
tables.scr.ScoreAnnouncement: An initial or re-announcement of scores, with the appeal window.
tables.scr.ScoreAnnouncementItem: The score snapshot published to one candidate in an announcement. Candidates see only this.
tables.ops.AuditEvent: Append-only audit trail of actions: who acted, in which role and through which client, on what, when and with what outcome. Updates and deletes are blocked. Never holds data values or sensitive payloads.
tables.ops.DomainEventOutbox: Transactional outbox of domain events to publish to other systems.
tables.ops.IdempotencyKey: Stores request fingerprints and responses so repeated requests with the same key replay safely.
tables.ops.NotificationOutbox: Queue of notifications to send, de-duplicated and retried.
tables.ops.NotificationTemplate: Versioned notification text per template, channel and language.
tables.ops.ScheduledJobRun: History of scheduled jobs run in-process by the API's background service, with their results.

columns.PublicId: Opaque identifier exposed through the API. Internal numeric keys are never exposed.
columns.CreatedAt: UTC time the row was created.
columns.RowVersion: Concurrency token maintained by SQL Server, used to detect conflicting updates.
columns.IsTerminal: 1 when no further status change is allowed from this state.
columns.IsActive: 1 when available for use; 0 when retired (history is kept).
columns.VersionLabel: Human-readable label of this approved version.
columns.EffectiveTo: Last date this version applies. NULL means open ended.
columns.ApprovedBy: Name of the person who approved this version.
columns.ReasonText: Free-text reason entered by the requester.
columns.RequestedAt: UTC time the request was made.
columns.DecidedAt: UTC time the decision was made.
columns.DecisionNote: Free-text note recorded with the decision.
columns.VersionNo: Version counter, starting at 1 and increasing with each change.
columns.UpdatedAt: UTC time the row was last changed.
columns.UpdatedBy: User or service that last changed the row.
columns.ActorType: Kind of actor: candidate, staff, service or system.
columns.ActorCandidateId: Candidate who acted, when the actor is a candidate.
columns.ActorStaffUserId: Staff user who acted, when the actor is staff.
columns.ActorServiceName: Name of the service that acted, when the actor is a service.
columns.CorrelationId: Id that ties together all records produced by one business request.
columns.ExpiresAt: UTC time after which the record is no longer valid.
columns.DisplayLabel: Text label shown to the user.
columns.DisplayOrder: Position within its parent when displayed.
columns.ValuesJson: Field values of the section as JSON, validated against the form schema.
columns.SectionKey: Key of the application form section, from the fixed set of section keys.
columns.StaffUserId: Staff user this row refers to.
columns.AuditEventId: Audit event written for this change.
columns.ResolvedAt: UTC time the item was resolved.
columns.IsCurrent: 1 for the current row; older rows stay for history.
columns.CurrencyCode: Currency of the amount. Only AED is allowed.
columns.Amount: Monetary amount in the stated currency.
columns.ReceiptId: Receipt reference issued by the payment provider.
columns.IdempotencyKey: Client-supplied key that makes a retried request safe.
columns.DecidedByStaffUserId: Staff user who made the decision.
columns.RequestedByStaffUserId: Staff user who made the request.
columns.AssignedByStaffUserId: Staff user who made the assignment.
columns.UploadedByStaffUserId: Staff user who uploaded the file, if uploaded by staff.
columns.UploadedByCandidateId: Candidate who uploaded the file, if uploaded by a candidate.
columns.IsEnabled: 1 when the item is enabled for use.
columns.DecisionReasonCodeId: Reason code selected for the decision.
columns.ReplacementReasonCodeId: Reason code for replacing the file.
columns.ReconciledByStaffUserId: Staff user who reconciled the payment.
columns.ActiveProviderCode: Provider currently used for new payment sessions.
columns.PaymentRoutingConfigId: Routing configuration version used when the session was bound.
columns.WeightSetId: Scoring weight set version used for the calculation.
columns.ExecutedByStaffUserId: Staff user who executed the action.
columns.AnnouncedByStaffUserId: Staff user who published the announcement.
columns.Round1ScoreItemId: Round 1 score item involved in the difference.
columns.Round2ScoreItemId: Round 2 score item involved in the difference.
columns.RulesInheritedFromProgramId: Programme whose rules this programme inherits, if any.

specific.cfg.AdmissionCycle.StartDate: First day of the cycle. Its year is the first four digits of the cycle's application numbers.
specific.cfg.AnnouncementStatus.StatusCode: Announcement status code, equal to the API enum value.
specific.cfg.ApplicationStatus.StatusCode: Application status code, equal to the API enum value.
specific.cfg.PaymentStatus.StatusCode: Payment status code, equal to the API enum value.
specific.cfg.PortfolioRoundStatus.StatusCode: Portfolio round status code, equal to the API enum value.
specific.cfg.PortfolioStatus.StatusCode: Portfolio status code, equal to the API enum value.
specific.cfg.VerificationStatus.StatusCode: Verification status code, equal to the API enum value.
specific.cfg.Country.IsUae: 1 for the United Arab Emirates. Drives the GPA input path.
specific.cfg.GpaConversionBand.ScaleMin: Lower bound of the scale-of-4 GPA range.
specific.cfg.GpaConversionBand.ScaleMax: Upper bound of the scale-of-4 GPA range.
specific.cfg.GpaConversionBand.PercentMin: Lower bound of the resulting percentage.
specific.cfg.GpaConversionBand.PercentMax: Upper bound of the resulting percentage.
specific.cfg.Program.MaxPreferences: How many ranked specialty preferences a candidate may choose (1 or 2).
specific.cfg.ProgramCycle.ApplicationOpensAt: Time applications open. Configurable because BRD dates conflict.
specific.cfg.ProgramCycle.ApplicationClosesAt: Time applications close (submission deadline). Must be after the opening time.
specific.cfg.ProgramCycle.GracePeriodEndsAt: Grace-period deadline after the submission deadline: preference edits stop and unsubmitted drafts are archived after it.
specific.cfg.ProgramCycle.TimeZoneId: IANA time zone (default Asia/Dubai) in which the opening, closing and grace-period deadlines are defined.
specific.cfg.ReasonCode.ReasonCode: Reason code, unique within its category.
specific.cfg.ReasonCode.CandidateMessage: Message that may be shown to the candidate. Contains no internal detail.
specific.cfg.ReasonCode.SortOrder: Position of the reason in the drop-down list.
specific.cfg.ScoringWeightItem.MaxPoints: Maximum points the component can contribute.
specific.cfg.SpecialtySite.Capacity: Number of places at this site for the specialty. Nullable until the business confirms capacity.
specific.cfg.SystemParameter.ParameterValue: Value of the setting as text, read according to ValueType.
specific.cfg.SystemParameter.ValueType: How to interpret the value: INT, DECIMAL, BOOL, DATE or STRING.
specific.cfg.TrainingSite.SiteId: Surrogate key of the training site.
specific.cfg.University.UniversityName: University name, unique within its country.
specific.cfg.University.IsOther: 1 for the catch-all Other entry, which lets the candidate type a name.
specific.cfg.WorkingCalendarDay.IsWorkingDay: 1 when the date is a working day.
specific.cfg.WorkingCalendarDay.Description: Reason for a non-working day, such as a public holiday.
specific.cfg.WorkingCalendarDay.CalendarVersion: Version of the calendar this day belongs to.
specific.cfg.WorkPool.PoolType: Type of pool, such as verification, portfolio round 1 or second evaluation.
specific.cfg.WorkPool.RetrievalCap: Maximum items one user may retrieve at a time. NULL means no cap.
specific.cfg.DocumentType.DocumentTypeCode: Unique code of the document type, such as CV or PASSPORT_COPY.
specific.cfg.DocumentType.Name: Name of the document type shown to users.
specific.cfg.DocumentType.AllowedMediaTypes: Comma-separated list of accepted file types, such as application/pdf,image/jpeg.
specific.cfg.DocumentType.MaxSizeBytes: Largest accepted file size in bytes (2 MB unless stated otherwise).
specific.idn.Candidate.CandidateNumber: Candidate ID: 9-digit text from 000000001, leading zeros kept, generated from a sequence. Unique.
specific.idn.Candidate.Email: E-mail registered in IDAM (BRD 'Registered Email'), refreshed at sign-in. Personal data.
specific.idn.Candidate.MobileNumber: Mobile number registered in IDAM (BRD 'Registered Mobile Number'), refreshed at sign-in. Personal data. Stored as +<digits>; also used to detect duplicate accounts.
specific.idn.Candidate.IcpPersonRef: Reference to the person record in ICP.
specific.idn.Candidate.IdamUserId: IDAM immutable user identifier; the only key used to match a sign-in to this candidate. Unique.
specific.idn.Candidate.DisplayName: Name shown in screens, from the identity provider. Personal data.
specific.idn.Candidate.PreferredCulture: Preferred language and region for screens and notifications: ar-AE or en-AE.
specific.idn.Candidate.PreferredTimeZoneId: IANA time zone used to display times to the candidate. NULL means Asia/Dubai.
specific.idn.Candidate.EmiratesIdNumber: Emirates ID number from IDAM, digits only, used to detect duplicate accounts. Not unique, so a duplicate can be recorded. Personal data: never logged or audited.
specific.idn.Candidate.PassportNumber: Passport number from IDAM, letters and digits in upper case, used to detect duplicate accounts. Not unique. Personal data: never logged or audited.
specific.idn.IcpRefreshRequest.StatusCode: Refresh state: PREVIEWED, APPLIED, CANCELLED or EXPIRED.
specific.idn.IcpRefreshRequest.PreviewJson: ICP values of the ICP-sourced fields as previewed; the apply step uses these, not a new ICP call. Personal data.
specific.idn.IcpRefreshRequest.AppliedAt: UTC time the refresh was applied.
specific.idn.IcpRefreshRequest.RequestReasonCode: Why the refresh was requested: IDENTITY_EXPIRY or DETAILS_CHANGE.
specific.idn.IcpRefreshRequest.PreviewTokenHash: SHA-256 hash of the single-use preview token. NULL when nothing differed.
specific.idn.IcpRefreshRequest.SourceRowVersion: Profile row version at preview time; if it changed before apply, the preview is stale and is refused.
specific.idn.IcpRefreshRequest.ExpiresAt: UTC time the preview token stops being accepted.
specific.idn.StaffRoleAssignment.ValidFrom: First date the assignment is valid.
specific.idn.StaffRoleAssignment.ValidTo: Last date the assignment is valid. NULL means open ended.
specific.idn.StaffUser.IdamUserId: IDAM immutable user identifier; the key used to match a sign-in. NULL until a pre-registered user first signs in. Unique when present.
specific.idn.StaffUser.ActiveRoleCode: Role the user is currently acting in (role switcher). Must be one of the user's current role assignments.
specific.idn.StaffUser.LinkedCandidatePublicId: PublicId of the same person's candidate record, if any; used to stop staff acting on their own applications. Unique when present.
specific.idn.StaffUser.PreferredCulture: Preferred language and region: ar-AE or en-AE.
specific.idn.StaffUser.PreferredTimeZoneId: IANA time zone used to display times to the user. NULL means Asia/Dubai.
specific.idn.CandidatePersonalProfile.CandidateId: Candidate the profile belongs to (one profile per candidate).
specific.idn.CandidatePersonalProfile.EnglishFirs: First name in English, as in the passport. Personal data.
specific.idn.CandidatePersonalProfile.EnglishMidd: Middle name(s) in English; from ICP, the second to fourth names separated by spaces. Personal data.
specific.idn.CandidatePersonalProfile.EnglishLast: Last name in English. Personal data.
specific.idn.CandidatePersonalProfile.ArabicFirst: First name in Arabic. Personal data.
specific.idn.CandidatePersonalProfile.ArabicMiddl: Middle name(s) in Arabic. Personal data.
specific.idn.CandidatePersonalProfile.ArabicLastN: Last name in Arabic. Personal data.
specific.idn.CandidatePersonalProfile.DateOfBirth: Date of birth; must be in the past. Personal data.
specific.idn.CandidatePersonalProfile.MaritalStat: Marital status: SINGLE, MARRIED, DIVORCED or WIDOWED.
specific.idn.CandidatePersonalProfile.IsChildOfUa: Answer to 'Are you a child of a UAE National mother who holds a Family Book?' (non-UAE nationals). Yes makes the birth certificate and mother's family book required.
specific.idn.CandidatePersonalProfile.HasMarsoom: Answer to 'Do you have Marsoom?' (non-UAE nationals).
specific.idn.CandidatePersonalProfile.UaeResidenc: Emirate of residence, when the country of residence is the UAE.
specific.idn.CandidatePersonalProfile.HasEmirates: Answer to 'Do you have an Emirates ID?'.
specific.idn.CandidatePersonalProfile.EmiratesIdE: Emirates ID expiry date. An expired ID means no ICP data is retrieved. Personal data.
specific.idn.CandidatePersonalProfile.VisaUnified: Visa unified number (residents who are not UAE or GCC nationals). Personal data.
specific.idn.CandidatePersonalProfile.VisaFileNum: Residence visa file number. Personal data.
specific.idn.CandidatePersonalProfile.VisaPlaceOf: Place of issue of the residence visa.
specific.idn.CandidatePersonalProfile.VisaExpiryD: Residence visa expiry date. Personal data.
specific.idn.CandidatePersonalProfile.PassportIss: Country that issued the passport. Personal data.
Emirate of issue, when the passport was issued in the UAE.
City of issue as free text, when the passport was issued outside the UAE.
specific.idn.CandidatePersonalProfile.PassportExp: Passport expiry date; must be later than today. Personal data.
specific.idn.CandidatePersonalProfile.FamilyBookC: Family book city number (UAE nationals). Personal data.
specific.idn.CandidatePersonalProfile.FamilyId: Family ID (UAE nationals; ICP field khulasitQaidNo). Personal data.
specific.idn.CandidatePersonalProfile.PassportUni: Passport unified number (UAE nationals). Personal data.
specific.idn.CandidatePersonalProfile.ContactEmai: Contact e-mail; starts as the registered e-mail and needs a one-time-code check when changed. Personal data.
specific.idn.CandidatePersonalProfile.ContactMobi: Contact mobile number; starts as the registered mobile and needs a one-time-code check when changed. Personal data.
specific.idn.CandidatePersonalProfile.NextOfKinFi: Next of kin first name. Personal data.
specific.idn.CandidatePersonalProfile.NextOfKinMi: Next of kin middle name(s). Personal data.
specific.idn.CandidatePersonalProfile.NextOfKinSu: Next of kin surname. Personal data.
specific.idn.CandidatePersonalProfile.NextOfKinRe: Relationship of the next of kin to the candidate.
specific.idn.CandidatePersonalProfile.NextOfKinPh: Next of kin primary telephone number. Personal data.
specific.idn.CandidatePersonalProfile.NextOfKinEm: Next of kin primary e-mail. Personal data.
specific.idn.CandidatePersonalProfile.NextOfKinAr: Next of kin area of residence. Personal data.
specific.idn.CandidatePersonalProfile.IcpSourcedF: List of the fields whose current value came from ICP; these are highlighted and read-only on the form.
specific.idn.CandidatePersonalProfile.IcpRetrieve: UTC time the ICP data was last retrieved.
specific.idn.CandidatePersonalProfile.RowVersion: Concurrency token; copied into the submission snapshot and compared when an ICP preview is applied.
specific.idn.DuplicateAccountPair.PairId: Surrogate primary key, generated by the database.
specific.idn.DuplicateAccountPair.DuplicateCandid: The new account found to duplicate the original.
specific.idn.DuplicateAccountPair.MatchedOnPasspo: 1 when the passport (issuing country and number) matched.
specific.idn.DuplicateAccountPair.DetectedAt: UTC time the duplicate was detected at sign-in.
specific.idn.CandidateChangeHistory.ChangeId: Surrogate primary key, generated by the database.
specific.idn.CandidateChangeHistory.OldValue: Value before the change. Personal data.
specific.idn.CandidateChangeHistory.NewValue: Value after the change. Personal data.
specific.idn.CandidateChangeHistory.SourceCode: What made the change: ICP_REFRESH, CANDIDATE_EDIT or STAFF_CORRECTION.
specific.idn.CandidateChangeHistory.IcpRefreshReq: ICP refresh that made the change, for ICP_REFRESH changes.
specific.idn.CandidateChangeHistory.ChangedByCand: Candidate who made the change, for candidate edits.
specific.idn.CandidateChangeHistory.ChangedByStaf: Staff user who made or applied the change.
specific.idn.StaffWorkPool.ValidFrom: First day the user works the pool.
specific.idn.StaffWorkPool.ValidTo: Last day the user works the pool. NULL means open ended.
specific.idn.IntegrationClient.IdamClientId: Client id issued by IDAM to the calling system. Unique.
specific.idn.IntegrationClient.Name: Name of the calling system.
specific.app.Application.ApplicationNumber: Application ID shown to people and used to match CASPER rows: cycle start year plus a 7-digit counter, for example 20270000001. 11 digits, never starts with 0. Unique.
specific.app.Application.VersionNo: Version counter used for ETag and If-Match optimistic locking.
specific.app.Application.TermsVersion: Version of the terms the candidate accepted.
specific.app.Application.TermsAcceptedAt: UTC time the candidate accepted the terms.
specific.app.Application.LastSavedAt: UTC time the draft was last saved.
specific.app.Application.SubmittedAt: UTC time the application was submitted.
specific.app.Application.ArchivedAt: UTC time the draft was archived by the maintenance job.
specific.app.ApplicationPreference.PreferenceOrde: Rank of the preference: 1 or 2. Preference 1 is the reference choice.
specific.app.ApplicationPreferenceSite.SiteOrder: Order of the site within the preference, starting at 1.
specific.app.ApplicationPreferenceSite.ProgramSpe: Specialty of the parent preference. Repeated so the foreign key proves the site offers this specialty.
specific.app.ApplicationSection.ValuesJson: Field values of the section as JSON, validated against the form schema. Personal-information fields are not stored here.
specific.app.ApplicationSectionHistory.ChangeKind: Source of the change: DRAFT_SAVE, CORRECTION, ICP_REFRESH or SYSTEM.
specific.app.ApplicationSectionHistory.ChangedByC: Candidate who made the change, if any.
specific.app.ApplicationSectionHistory.ChangedByS: Staff user who made the change, if any.
specific.app.FormField.TooltipText: Help text shown beside the field.
specific.app.FormField.DataType: Field type, such as text, date, single select or file reference.
specific.app.FormField.IsVisible: 1 when the field is shown by default.
specific.app.FormField.IsRequired: 1 when the field is required by default.
specific.app.FormField.IsReadOnly: 1 when the candidate cannot edit the value (for example data from ICP).
specific.app.FormField.ConstraintsJson: Validation rules such as length, range or pattern, as JSON.
specific.app.FormFieldCondition.DependsOnFieldCod: Code of the field whose value drives the condition.
specific.app.FormFieldCondition.Operator: Comparison operator, such as EQ, IN, GT or EMPTY.
specific.app.FormFieldCondition.ValueJson: Value to compare with, as JSON.
specific.app.FormSection.Title: Section title shown to the candidate.
specific.app.ReinstatementRequest.Justification: The candidate's mandatory justification (up to 1000 characters).
specific.app.ReinstatementRequest.DecisionReasonC: Rejection reason from lookup REINSTATEMENT_REJECTION_REASON. Required when rejected.
specific.app.ReinstatementRequest.DecisionNote: Supervisor's mandatory note, recorded with any decision.
specific.app.SiteExclusion.ReasonText: The candidate's mandatory reason for the exclusion (up to 500 characters); one reason covers all sites excluded together.
specific.app.SiteExclusion.ExcludedAt: UTC time the site was excluded.
specific.app.SiteExclusion.ReasonCodeId: Reserved for a future reason list; the BRD asks for free text only.
specific.app.WithdrawalRequest.OtpProviderRef: Reference to the one-time-password challenge at the provider. The code itself is never stored.
specific.app.WithdrawalRequest.ExpiresAt: UTC time the confirmation window ends.
specific.app.WithdrawalRequest.ConfirmedAt: UTC time the candidate confirmed. Set only when confirmed.
specific.app.WithdrawalRequest.OtherReasonText: Free-text reason, required when the reason is OTHER (at least 3 letters).
specific.app.WithdrawalRequest.OtpLastSentAt: UTC time the last one-time code was sent.
specific.app.WithdrawalRequest.OtpResendCount: Number of times the code was resent.
specific.app.WithdrawalRequest.ResendAvailableAt: Earliest UTC time a new code can be requested (resend cooldown).
specific.app.ApplicationNumberCounter.AdmissionCy: Admission cycle the counter belongs to.
specific.app.ApplicationNumberCounter.CycleStartY: Year the cycle starts; the first four digits of its application numbers. Unique.
specific.app.ApplicationPersonalSnapshot.Snapshot: Personal-information fields as submitted. Personal data.
specific.app.ApplicationPersonalSnapshot.ProfileR: Row version of the profile the snapshot was taken from.
specific.app.ApplicationPersonalSnapshot.TakenAt: UTC time the snapshot was taken (submission).
specific.app.ScreenOutReinstatement.RestoredAppli: Application status restored (the status before the screen-out).
specific.app.ContactVerification.ApplicationId: Application being edited when the check started, if any.
specific.app.ContactVerification.ValueHash: SHA-256 hash of the e-mail or mobile number being verified. The value itself is not stored here.
specific.app.ContactVerification.OtpProviderRef: Reference to the one-time-code challenge at the provider. The code itself is never stored.
specific.app.ContactVerification.ExpiresAt: UTC time the issued code stops being accepted.
specific.app.ContactVerification.ResendAvailableA: Earliest UTC time a new code can be requested (resend cooldown).
specific.app.ContactVerification.ResendCount: Number of times the code was resent.
specific.app.ContactVerification.VerifiedAt: UTC time the code was confirmed.
specific.app.ContactVerification.ValidUntil: UTC time by which the profile must be saved with the verified value; afterwards a new check is needed.
specific.doc.Attachment.Purpose: What the file is for: APPLICATION_FORM, PORTFOLIO_EVIDENCE, PAYMENT_RECEIPT or CASPER_IMPORT.
specific.doc.Attachment.SectionKey: Form section the file belongs to, when applicable.
specific.doc.Attachment.FieldCode: Form field the file belongs to, when applicable.
specific.doc.Attachment.IsDeleted: 1 when the attachment was removed. Versions are kept.
specific.doc.Attachment.DocumentTypeId: Type of document, which sets the allowed file types and size. NULL for CASPER imports.
specific.doc.Attachment.SpecialtyId: Specialty a per-specialty document belongs to, such as a recommendation letter for a preference.
specific.doc.AttachmentVersion.VersionNo: Version number of the file, starting at 1.
specific.doc.AttachmentVersion.FileNetDocumentRef: Reference to the file in FileNet, set once Rhapsody confirms storage. The file content is not in this database.
specific.doc.AttachmentVersion.Sha256: SHA-256 hash of the content for integrity checks.
specific.doc.AttachmentVersion.ReplacementNote: Note explaining why staff replaced the file.
specific.doc.AttachmentVersion.StorageStatusCode: Where the file is in the Rhapsody-to-FileNet flow: PENDING, STORED, FAILED or PURGED.
specific.doc.AttachmentVersion.RhapsodyCorrelatio: Correlation id of the hand-off to Rhapsody.
specific.doc.AttachmentVersion.StoredAt: UTC time FileNet storage was confirmed.
specific.doc.AttachmentVersion.PurgedAt: UTC time the file was removed by the document-orphan-cleanup job (rules still open).
specific.pay.FeeSchedule.FeeType: Type of fee, such as the application fee.
specific.pay.PaymentGatewayEvent.ProviderEventId: Event id from the provider. With the provider code it is unique, so replays are ignored.
specific.pay.PaymentGatewayEvent.ProcessingOutcom: How it was handled: APPLIED, DUPLICATE_IGNORED or MISMATCH_REJECTED.
specific.pay.PaymentGatewayEvent.StatusCode: Payment status reported by the provider.
specific.pay.PaymentProviderBinding.ProviderSessi: Provider's id for the checkout session.
specific.pay.PaymentProviderBinding.CheckoutUrl: URL the candidate is sent to for payment.
specific.pay.PaymentProviderBinding.CheckoutExpir: UTC time the checkout link expires.
specific.pay.PaymentProviderBinding.BoundAt: UTC time the provider was bound to the session.
specific.pay.PaymentReconciliation.OutcomeCode: Result, such as confirmed paid, confirmed failed, still unknown or duplicate charge.
specific.pay.PaymentRoutingConfiguration.Configur: Unique version label of the routing setting.
specific.pay.PaymentRoutingConfiguration.Effectiv: UTC time this routing takes effect.
specific.pay.PaymentSession.Amount: Amount charged, copied from the fee schedule when the session started.
specific.pay.PaymentSession.PaidAt: UTC time payment was confirmed. Required when status is PAID.
specific.ver.CorrectionFlag.FieldPointer: Path to the flagged field inside the application data.
specific.ver.CorrectionFlag.Comment: What the candidate needs to correct.
specific.ver.CorrectionFlag.FlaggedAt: UTC time the field was flagged.
specific.ver.CorrectionRequest.DueAt: UTC time by which the candidate must resubmit (correction grace period, in working days).
specific.ver.CorrectionRequest.TimeZoneId: IANA time zone (default Asia/Dubai) in which the due date was set.
specific.ver.ScreenOutRecommendation.Justificatio: Officer's optional note (up to 500 characters); whether it is mandatory is still open.
specific.ver.ScreenOutRecommendation.DecisionCode: Supervisor decision: ENDORSE_SCREEN_OUT or REJECT_SCREEN_OUT. NULL while pending.
specific.ver.ScreenOutRecommendation.ReasonCodeId: Officer's screen-out reason from lookup SCREEN_OUT_REASON. Kept even if the supervisor endorses with another reason.
specific.ver.ScreenOutRecommendation.EndorsedReas: Screen-out reason chosen by the supervisor on endorsement, when it replaces the officer's reason.
specific.ver.VerificationAssignment.WorkPoolId: Work pool the case was taken from.
specific.ver.VerificationAssignment.RetrievedAt: UTC time the officer retrieved the case from the pool. NULL when assigned by a supervisor.
specific.ver.VerificationAssignment.DueAt: UTC time the review is due; after it the case returns to the pool automatically.
specific.ver.VerificationAssignment.EndReasonCode: Why the assignment ended: COMPLETED, REASSIGNED, RETURNED_TO_POOL, AUTO_RETURNED, SENT_TO_CANDIDATE or SENT_TO_SUPERVISOR.
specific.ver.VerificationAssignment.Justification: Supervisor's reason for a reassignment or return to pool.
specific.ver.VerificationCase.StatusCode: Verification status. Independent of the application and portfolio statuses.
specific.ver.VerificationCase.OpenedAt: UTC time the case was opened.
specific.ver.VerificationEvent.EventType: Kind of event on the case timeline.
specific.pfo.Appeal.SubmittedAt: UTC time the candidate filed the appeal.
specific.pfo.Appeal.StatusCode: Appeal state, such as SUBMITTED, ELIGIBLE, INELIGIBLE, SECOND_EVALUATION or CLOSED.
specific.pfo.ConflictOfInterest.DeclaredAt: UTC time the referee declared the conflict.
specific.pfo.ConflictOfInterest.Reason: The referee's mandatory reason (up to 500 characters).
specific.pfo.Portfolio.SubmittedAt: UTC time the candidate submitted. After this the answers are locked.
specific.pfo.PortfolioAnswer.Answer: YES or NO answer to the question.
specific.pfo.PortfolioAnswer.DetailsJson: Extra details the question asks for, as JSON.
specific.pfo.PortfolioDiscrepancy.DetectedAt: UTC time the difference was detected.
specific.pfo.PortfolioQuestion.QuestionCode: Question code, unique within the rubric version.
specific.pfo.PortfolioQuestion.QuestionText: Question text shown to the candidate.
specific.pfo.PortfolioQuestion.DetailsSchemaJson: Definition of the extra details the question collects.
specific.pfo.PortfolioQuestion.EvidenceSchemaJson: Definition of the evidence the question accepts.
specific.pfo.PortfolioQuestion.MaxScore: Highest score the question can earn.
specific.pfo.PortfolioQuestion.PublicId: Opaque question id used by the API, for example in appeal responses.
specific.pfo.PortfolioRound.RoundCode: ROUND_1, ROUND_2, ROUND_3 (only on discrepancy) or SECOND_EVALUATION (only on appeal).
specific.pfo.PortfolioRound.TotalScore: Total score given in this round.
specific.pfo.PortfolioScoreHistory.IsFinal: 1 when this is a final score. The latest final row is the effective score.
specific.pfo.PortfolioScoreHistory.RecordedAt: UTC time the score was recorded.
specific.pfo.QuestionClassification.Classificatio: Classification option a referee can pick.
specific.pfo.RoundAssignment.IsCurrent: 1 for the current referee on the round.
specific.pfo.RoundAssignment.RetrievedAt: UTC time the referee retrieved the portfolio from the pool. NULL when assigned by the senior referee.
specific.pfo.RoundAssignment.DueAt: UTC time scoring is due; after it the portfolio returns to the pool automatically.
specific.pfo.RoundAssignment.EndReasonCode: Why the assignment ended: SUBMITTED, REASSIGNED, AUTO_RETURNED, COI_RETURNED or ON_HOLD.
specific.pfo.RubricVersion.IsActive: 1 for the active rubric of the program cycle. Only one may be active.
specific.pfo.ScoreItem.ScoredAt: UTC time the item was scored.
specific.pfo.AppealQuestion.CandidateComment: The candidate's response for the flagged question (up to 200 characters).
specific.pfo.PortfolioStatusHistory.ChangedByStaf: Staff user who caused the change. NULL for system changes.
specific.pfo.PortfolioStatusHistory.Reason: Short code for why the status changed, such as WITHDRAWN, SCREENED_OUT, ARCHIVED, REINSTATED, DISCREPANCY, APPEAL or OVERDUE.
specific.pfo.RoundScoreOverride.NewTotalScore: Round total set by the senior referee; not more than the question set total.
specific.pfo.RoundScoreOverride.OverriddenByStaff: Senior referee who made the override.
specific.scr.ApplicationScoreComponent.ComponentC: Which component: GPA, exam, portfolio or CASPER.
specific.scr.ApplicationScreening.CasperScore: Weighted CASPER score. Does not gate the initial announcement.
specific.scr.ApplicationScreening.CalculatedAt: UTC time of the last calculation.
specific.scr.ApplicationScreening.CasperAttendanc: CASPER attendance: NA until results are known, then ATTENDED or ABSENT.
specific.scr.BulkScreenOut.CriteriaJson: Selection criteria used for the action.
specific.scr.CasperImport.UploadVersion: Version number of the upload within the cycle.
specific.scr.CasperImportRow.ApplicationNumber: The digits of the received Application ID when they form a valid application number; used to match the application.
specific.scr.CasperImportRow.ExceptionReason: Why the row was not applied.
specific.scr.CasperImportRow.ApplicationNumberRaw: The Application ID cell read as text, exactly as received.
specific.scr.ScoreAnnouncement.IdempotencyKey: Key that prevents the same announcement being run twice. Unique.
specific.scr.ScoreAnnouncement.AnnouncedAt: UTC time the scores were announced.
specific.scr.ScoreAnnouncement.AppealWindowEndsAt: UTC time the appeal window closes. The window starts at the announcement.
specific.scr.ScoreAnnouncement.TimeZoneId: IANA time zone (default Asia/Dubai) in which the appeal window is defined.
specific.scr.ScoreAnnouncementItem.PublishedCompo: Component breakdown shown to the candidate.
specific.ops.AuditEvent.ResourceId: Id of the record acted on, as text.
specific.ops.AuditEvent.ApplicationId: Application concerned. Deliberately not a foreign key so audit survives deletion.
specific.ops.AuditEvent.ReasonCode: Reason code given for the action.
specific.ops.AuditEvent.RequestId: Request id from the API call.
specific.ops.AuditEvent.ActiveRoleCode: Role the staff actor was acting in.
specific.ops.AuditEvent.IntegrationClientId: Integration client that made the call ('user X via client Y'). Deliberately not a foreign key.
specific.ops.AuditEvent.DetailJson: Extra non-sensitive metadata as JSON. Never field values.
specific.ops.DomainEventOutbox.EventId: Unique event id used by consumers to remove duplicates.
specific.ops.DomainEventOutbox.EventType: Name of the event, such as application.submitted.
specific.ops.DomainEventOutbox.AggregateType: Type of record the event is about.
specific.ops.DomainEventOutbox.AggregateId: Id of the record the event is about.
specific.ops.DomainEventOutbox.RecordedAt: UTC time written to the outbox.
specific.ops.DomainEventOutbox.PublishedAt: UTC time published. NULL while waiting.
specific.ops.IdempotencyKey.KeyScope: Operation and caller the key applies to.
specific.ops.IdempotencyKey.KeyValue: Key from the Idempotency-Key header, at least 16 characters.
specific.ops.IdempotencyKey.RequestHash: Hash of the original request, to detect the same key with a different request.
specific.ops.IdempotencyKey.ResponseStatus: HTTP status of the stored response.
specific.ops.IdempotencyKey.ResourceId: Id of the resource the first request created.
specific.ops.NotificationOutbox.DedupeKey: Key that prevents sending the same notification twice. Unique when present.
specific.ops.NotificationOutbox.NextAttemptAt: UTC time of the next attempt.
specific.ops.NotificationOutbox.ProviderMessageRe: Message id from the delivery provider.
specific.ops.NotificationTemplate.LanguageCode: Language tag, such as en or ar.
specific.ops.NotificationTemplate.Subject: Subject line.
specific.ops.ScheduledJobRun.JobCode: Name of the job: application-maintenance, verification-maintenance or document-orphan-cleanup.

constraints.CK_Application_Submitted: A submitted application must have a submission time; only drafts and archived applications may lack one. A draft cannot be withdrawn.
constraints.UX_Application_LivePerCandidateProgramCy: A candidate may have only one live (not withdrawn or archived) application per programme cycle.
constraints.CK_ApplicationPreference_Order: A preference is rank 1 or 2, so at most two per application.
constraints.UQ_ApplicationPreference_Order: Each rank is used once per application.
constraints.UQ_ApplicationPreference_Specialty: The same specialty cannot be chosen twice in one application.
constraints.UQ_ApplicationPreference_WithSpecialty: Supports the composite foreign key that ties each site choice to the same specialty.
constraints.UQ_ApplicationPreferenceSite_Order: Each site order is used once per preference.
constraints.UQ_ApplicationPreferenceSite_Site: The same site cannot be chosen twice for one specialty.
constraints.UQ_ApplicationSection: One current row per section per application.
constraints.UQ_FormField: Field codes are unique within a section.
constraints.UQ_FormSchemaVersion: Version labels are unique per programme.
constraints.UQ_FormSection: Section keys are unique within a form version.
constraints.CK_FormSchemaVersion_Dates: End date cannot be before the start date.
constraints.CK_ReinstatementRequest_Decision: A submitted request has no decision details; a decided request must have decision time, decider and note.
constraints.UX_ReinstatementRequest_OnePending: Only one open (submitted) reinstatement request per application.
constraints.UQ_SiteExclusion_Site: A site choice can be excluded only once.
constraints.CK_WithdrawalRequest_Confirmed: Confirmation time is set only when the request is confirmed.
constraints.CK_Attachment_Owner: A file must belong to an application unless it is a CASPER import.
constraints.CK_AttachmentVersion_Uploader: A file version is uploaded by a candidate or by staff, not both.
constraints.CK_StaffRoleAssignment_Dates: Validity end cannot be before its start.
constraints.TR_AuditEvent_Immutable: Trigger: blocks updates and deletes so the audit trail is append-only.
constraints.CK_IdempotencyKey_Length: Idempotency keys must be at least 16 characters.
constraints.UQ_IdempotencyKey: A key is unique within its scope.
constraints.CK_NotificationOutbox_Recipient: A notification needs a candidate or staff recipient.
constraints.UX_NotificationOutbox_Dedupe: A de-duplication key can be used only once.
constraints.UQ_NotificationTemplate: One template per code, channel, language and version.
constraints.CK_FeeSchedule_Amount: Fee must be greater than zero.
constraints.CK_FeeSchedule_Dates: End date cannot be before the start date.
constraints.UQ_FeeSchedule: One fee per programme cycle, fee type and start date.
constraints.CK_PaymentGatewayEvent_Amount: Event amount must be greater than zero.
constraints.UQ_PaymentGatewayEvent: A provider event is processed once; replays are detected.
constraints.TR_PaymentProviderBinding_Immutable: Trigger: blocks changes so a session never switches provider.
constraints.UQ_PaymentProviderBinding_Provider: A provider session reference is used by one binding only.
constraints.CK_PaymentSession_Amount: Amount must be greater than zero.
constraints.CK_PaymentSession_Paid: A paid session must have a payment time.
constraints.UQ_PaymentSession_Idempotency: A client key creates only one session per application.
constraints.UX_PaymentSession_OneOpen: Only one open (not paid, failed or cancelled) session per application and fee.
constraints.UX_PaymentSession_OnePaid: Only one paid session per application and fee, which prevents double payment.
constraints.UQ_ConflictOfInterest: A referee can declare a conflict once per portfolio.
constraints.TR_PortfolioAnswer_Immutable: Trigger: blocks changes to answers after the portfolio is submitted.
constraints.UQ_PortfolioAnswer: One answer per question per portfolio.
constraints.UQ_PortfolioAnswer_Question: Supports a composite foreign key that checks the question matches.
constraints.UQ_PortfolioQuestion: Question codes are unique within a rubric.
constraints.UQ_PortfolioRound: Each round occurs once per portfolio.
constraints.UQ_QuestionClassification: A classification is defined once per question.
constraints.UQ_QuestionRejectionReason: A rejection reason is defined once per question.
constraints.TR_RoundAssignment_Rules: Trigger: one referee per portfolio and no assignment after a declared conflict.
constraints.UX_RoundAssignment_Current: Only one current referee per round.
constraints.UQ_RubricVersion: Version numbers are unique per programme cycle.
constraints.UX_RubricVersion_Active: Only one active rubric per programme cycle.
constraints.CK_ScoreItem_Reject: A rejected item must score zero.
constraints.UQ_ScoreItem: One score per answer per round.
constraints.CK_AdmissionCycle_Dates: End date cannot be before the start date.
constraints.CK_GpaConversionBand_Percent: Percent range stays within 0-100 and the maximum is not below the minimum.
constraints.CK_GpaConversionBand_Scale: GPA range stays within 0-4 and the maximum is not below the minimum.
constraints.UQ_GpaConversionBand: A band starts at each GPA value once per set.
constraints.CK_GpaConversionSet_Dates: End date cannot be before the start date.
constraints.CK_Program_MaxPreferences: A programme allows one or two preferences.
constraints.CK_ProgramCycle_Window: The closing time must be after the opening time.
constraints.UQ_ProgramCycle_ProgramCycle: A programme is opened once per cycle.
constraints.UQ_ProgramSpecialty: A specialty is mapped once to a programme.
constraints.UQ_ReasonCode: Reason codes are unique within a category.
constraints.CK_ScoringWeightSet_Dates: End date cannot be before the start date.
constraints.UQ_ScoringWeightSet: Set labels are unique per programme.
constraints.CK_SpecialtySite_Capacity: Capacity is empty or zero or more.
constraints.UQ_SpecialtySite: A site is mapped once to a programme specialty.
constraints.UQ_SpecialtySite_WithSpecialty: Supports the composite foreign key that keeps a chosen site inside its specialty.
constraints.UQ_University: A university name is unique within a country.
constraints.CK_WorkPool_Cap: A retrieval cap is empty or above zero.
constraints.UX_ApplicationScoreComponent_Current: One current row per component per application.
constraints.UQ_CasperImport_Version: Upload versions are unique per cycle.
constraints.UQ_CasperImportRow: A row number occurs once per import.
constraints.UX_CasperResult_Current: One current CASPER result per application.
constraints.UQ_ScoreAnnouncement_Idempotency: The same announcement cannot run twice.
constraints.CK_ScreenOutRecommendation_Consistent: Decision, decision time and decider are all set or all empty.
constraints.CK_ScreenOutRecommendation_Decider: The decider cannot be the person who recommended.
constraints.CK_ScreenOutRecommendation_Decision: The decision is empty while pending, otherwise ENDORSE_SCREEN_OUT or REJECT_SCREEN_OUT.
constraints.UX_VerificationAssignment_Current: Only one current officer per case.
constraints.CK_Application_Number: The application number is 11 digits and does not start with 0.
constraints.CK_ApplicationNumberCounter_Year: The start year has four digits.
constraints.UQ_ApplicationNumberCounter_Year: Two cycles cannot start in the same year, so application numbers cannot collide across cycles.
constraints.CK_ReinstatementRequest_RejectReason: A rejection must have a rejection reason.
constraints.CK_ScreenOutReinstatement_Justification: The justification has at least 3 characters.
constraints.CK_ScreenOutReinstatement_Restored: The restored application status cannot be Screened out.
constraints.CK_ContactVerification_Verified: Verification time and validity end are both set or both empty.
constraints.CK_DocumentType_MaxSize: The maximum size is above zero.
constraints.CK_ProgramCycle_GracePeriod: The grace-period deadline cannot be before the closing time.
constraints.CK_Candidate_Number: The candidate number is exactly 9 digits.
constraints.CK_Candidate_Culture: Preferred culture is empty, ar-AE or en-AE.
constraints.CK_StaffUser_Culture: Preferred culture is empty, ar-AE or en-AE.
constraints.UX_StaffUser_IdamUserId: One staff user per IDAM user.
constraints.UX_StaffUser_LinkedCandidate: A candidate record can be linked to only one staff user.
constraints.CK_StaffWorkPool_Dates: Validity end cannot be before its start.
constraints.CK_CandidatePersonalProfile_Gender: Gender is empty, MALE or FEMALE.
constraints.CK_CandidatePersonalProfile_MaritalStatu: Marital status is empty or one of SINGLE, MARRIED, DIVORCED, WIDOWED.
constraints.CK_CandidateChangeHistory_Actor: A change is made by a candidate or by staff, not both.
constraints.CK_CandidateChangeHistory_IcpRefresh: An ICP_REFRESH change must name the ICP refresh request.
constraints.CK_DuplicateAccountPair_Matched: At least one attribute (Emirates ID, passport or mobile) matched.
constraints.UQ_DuplicateAccountPair: A pair of accounts is recorded once.
constraints.CK_IcpRefreshRequest_Applied: Applied time is set only when the refresh was applied.
constraints.CK_AttachmentVersion_Stored: A version marked STORED must have its FileNet reference.
constraints.CK_ScreenOutRecommendation_EndorsedReaso: A replacement reason is allowed only on endorsement.
constraints.CK_ScreenOutRecommendation_RejectNote: Rejecting a recommendation requires a note.
constraints.CK_VerificationAssignment_EndReason: End reason is empty or one of COMPLETED, REASSIGNED, RETURNED_TO_POOL, AUTO_RETURNED, SENT_TO_CANDIDATE, SENT_TO_SUPERVISOR.
constraints.CK_VerificationAssignment_Ended: A current assignment has no end; an ended assignment has an end time and reason.
constraints.CK_RoundAssignment_EndReason: End reason is empty or one of SUBMITTED, REASSIGNED, AUTO_RETURNED, COI_RETURNED, ON_HOLD.
constraints.CK_RoundAssignment_Ended: A current assignment has no end; an ended assignment has an end time and reason.
